subject: Metering collector oncall handshake and collector config
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marketplace Ops <mp-ops@acme-platform.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Metering collector oncall handshake and collector config

Hi team,

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier — attaching the collector schema (collector_schema_v2.json) and our deployment checklist (metering-deploy-checklist.pdf). We want to align on two things before kickoff:

1) Ingestion SLA & latency expectations: we typically accept up to 90s per event in the ingest path for initial launch, but customer dashboards rely on sub-60s for billing-reconciled metrics. Can you confirm the expected ingest latency on your side and whether there are any batching policies that would introduce >60s delays?

2) Oncall and ticketing path: we need a clear escalation for production metering gaps so customers aren’t incorrectly charged. Proposed path: Marketplace Ops -> Redwood Platform SRE (oncall) -> Redwood Billing Ops. Do you have a preferred first-contact alias?

Action items for you:
- Confirm ingest latency and any known batching windows
- Provide a cc-able alias for first-response / PagerDuty channel
- Validate collector_schema_v2.json (I called out the entitlement_id field mapping)

We plan a dry-run next Wednesday (2027-07-21) and will create a Jira ticket for the run. Looping in Ben and Karthik to coordinate the runbook.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: collector_schema_v2.json (application/json), metering-deploy-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Marketplace Ops <mp-ops@acme-platform.com>

Marissa —

On Sun, Jul 18, 2027 at 09:12 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the quick sync earlier — attaching the collector schema...

Thanks for the artifacts. Quick answers:
- Ingest latency: our standard ingestion pipeline aims for <45s median and <120s p99 for single-event pushes. We do have a hourly aggregation job that will batch older events for cost reasons; it is disabled for accounts in the "realtime-billing" tier (which you are in).
- First-response alias: mp-ops-oncall@acme-platform.com (this rings our primary oncall rota and creates a PagerDuty incident).
- Schema: entitlement_id mapping looks good but we have one ask on the seat_count field — we need it to be an integer and present for seat-based SKUs; if absent we'll treat the event as metered-by-usage (consumption).

We created a short internal thread for the dry-run and will confirm the run window by EOD Monday. Also, procurement@acme.com will need a short statement of work for the integration (we'll accept the checklist as a runbook appendix).

— Marketplace Ops (Ravi)
mp-ops@acme-platform.com

Attachment: none

Thanks Ravi — good to have the alias.

Marissa / Karthik, I'll own the Jira ticket INF-3042 and set up the runbook skeleton. Proposed oncall rotation for the dry-run week (also in runbook-oncall-rotation.md):

- Night coverage (6p-9a PT): Redwood Billing Ops (primary) -> oncall pager for Redwood infra

I'll also add an automated sanity check that validates we see entitlement_id and seat_count for seat SKUs within 5 minutes of the test event — if not, a high-priority PagerDuty fires.

I created the Jira and linked it here: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-3042

Ben Carter

ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Metering collector oncall handshake and collector config

Folks —

Two small technical notes after reviewing collector_schema_v2.json:
1) Fallback behavior: if seat_count is missing but entitlement_id maps to a seat SKU, we should emit a metric with "seat_unknown":true and route to a soft-fail pipeline that does not increment billing counters until human confirmation. This prevents accidental overbilling.
2) Timestamp precision: please ensure the collector uses ISO8601 with milliseconds and timezone (e.g., 2027-07-18T16:44:12.123Z). Our ingestion dedup logic uses ms to correlate retries.

Also, for the dry-run I'll stand by to help with the entitlement mapping table — I added a sample mapping CSV to the S3 bucket linked above.

Karthik Iyer
Platform Integrations Engineer
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

All —

Appreciate the quick responses and the alias. Summary and next steps:
- Marketplace Ops confirms mp-ops-oncall@acme-platform.com as first-response (Ravi).
- Redwood will enforce the soft-fail for missing seat_count for seat SKUs; Karthik will add the flag and the dedup ms requirement.
- Ben will own INF-3042 and the runbook; dry-run scheduled for 2027-07-21 10:00 PT.
- Procurement: Marissa will send the SOW appendix and checklist to procurement@acme.com after the dry-run completes successfully.

If nothing else pops up, I'll close this thread after the dry-run and attach the final runbook. Thanks everyone — see you on Wednesday.

Best,
